主要内容: On March 1, 2018, the Board of Directors of Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. appointed Dr. Kimberly E. Ritrievi as a director and member of the Audit and Compensation Committees, effective as of March 1, 2018. Dr. Ritrievi will receive the Company’s standard compensation for non-employee directors. She has no family relationships with any director or executive officer of the Company, and there were no arrangements or understandings with any person pursuant to which she was selected as a director. No transactions involving Dr. Ritrievi require disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.
